snippet.title: Friends Vs Friends | Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Friends vs Friends is OUT NOW on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S!

https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008051/
https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9mwcj0lcr9g6

Play 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or even Free-For-All in online, fast-paced, chaotic combat! Gain player levels, get new cards, improve the ones you already have, and get to know an array of eclectic characters with their own unique passive skills.
